summary: Cloudflare for Startups gives early-stage companies up to $350K in credits for one year across three tiers — $10K (bootstrapped/self-funded, <$1M raised), $100K (<$5M raised, affiliated-partner funded), $350K ($5M+ raised, affiliated-partner funded). Existing Enterprise customers, educational institutions, personal blogs, consultancies, service-based agencies, MSPs and resellers are excluded. Credits cover usage-based services: Workers, Durable Objects, Workflows, Workers AI (capped $2.5K/$10K/$50K by tier), R2 (capped $10K), Pages, Images, Stream; core security/networking features are included at no cost. AI Gateway is temporarily not covered; Registrar registration/renewal fees, premium network services and Enterprise feature add-ons by default are also excluded. Add-on access can be requested; premium network services require a dedicated contracted plan. A valid payment method must be on file. Overages are automatically billed, and after credits expire Cloudflare bills the card unless you enter a contract for prepaid services. The Startup Plan terms exclude an SLA despite marketing mentioning one.
claim_steps: Confirm eligibility: for-profit, founded within 10 years, funded up to Series B within the last 12 months, building a technology product, public website, active on LinkedIn/X/GitHub, first-time applicant, business email matching your domain.
Existing Enterprise customers, educational institutions, personal blogs, consultancies, service-based agencies, MSPs and resellers are excluded.
Create a Cloudflare account and add a valid payment method as required by the program.
Credits last one year or until consumed. Monitor Workers AI/R2 caps: overages are automatically billed. Before graduation, select or downgrade your plan and disable unwanted billable usage.

AI Gateway and Registrar registration/renewal fees are not covered. Enterprise feature add-ons are excluded by default; request access by email. Premium network services require a dedicated contracted plan.

social_proof.title: Startup Program | Cloudflare
social_proof.text: Cloudflare for Startups gives early-stage companies up to $350k in credits. Workers AI: Covered up to a $2,500 cap for Tier 3, $10,000 for Tier 2, and $50,000 for Tier 1. Credits are valid for one year or until fully consumed.

social_proof.title: Startup Plan payment and overage terms
social_proof.text: You will be automatically billed for any overages. You will be required to create a Cloudflare account and upload a valid payment method on file.

social_proof.title: Startup Plan SLA and post-credit billing terms
social_proof.text: The Startup Plan does not include a service level agreement. Upon expiration of credits, Cloudflare will bill your credit card on file unless you enter into a contract for prepaid services.
